fetch_method: service.archief.nl/api/file/v1/default/{uuid} (native resolution JPEG), one request at a time, >=1.5s apart

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0100.jpg
scans.finding: Ottoman/Arabic-script document (not Dutch cursive); unrelated item in this mixed Levant file.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0230.jpg
scans.finding: Italian bill-of-exchange entry, "Laus Deo en Smirne 16 8bre 1621"; resolution text headed "Op huyden den 26 November 1621", mentions Cornelio Haga and Smirna (Smyrna) but is a financial resolution, not the target letter.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0252.jpg
scans.finding: Dutch instruction/resolution re Algiers and Tunis negotiations; margin note "9 february 1622"; mentions "den Oratuer Haga" in passing (instruction text, not a Haga despatch).

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0274.jpg
scans.finding: Docket: "date le 10 Decembre 1621 / Recu 5 january 1622"; a different correspondent (Cornel Baldron/Spanish-Imperial military affairs), not Haga. First clear example of the docket format (Datum/written + Recu/received).

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0300.jpg
scans.finding: Docket: "Gheschreven 3 maert 1622"; French letter re silk bales ex Venice via Amsterdam, signed Christoffel Jurriaens -- unrelated correspondent.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0320.jpg
scans.finding: Docket: "Dat 28 maert / Recep 14 april 1622"; unrelated correspondent (troop/regiment matter). Key calendar anchor: written 28 Mar, received 14 Apr 1622.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0327.jpg
scans.finding: No docket visible in this spread; right-hand page carries a news paragraph "Uyt de brieven van Constantinopele" reporting Sultan Osman's deposition/death and Sultan Mustafa's succession (the May 1622 Ottoman regicide) -- a digest/newsletter item, not an addressed despatch.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0328.jpg
scans.finding: Docket: "Date 17 juny / Recepto 7 july 1622"; right-hand page again opens on Constantinopel news (Sultan Osman/Mustafa). Second key calendar anchor: written 17 Jun, received 7 Jul 1622.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0330.jpg
scans.finding: Docket: "dd 5 juli 1622"; Milan military-affairs letter, unrelated correspondent.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0340.jpg
scans.finding: Docket not fully resolved on this pass; left-page corner carries an address note reading "...Constantinopoli" and the body opens "Hooghe ende mogende Heeren"; most likely a Haga Constantinopel letter, received around late July 1622 (consistent with the 320/328 calendar anchors) -- later than the 16/30 April target, not re-examined closely given the budget.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0350.jpg
scans.finding: Resolution dated "s Gravenhage den 12 augusti 1622" on the facing page; loose note dated "Lactum 22 augusti 1622" -- August 1622, confirms the volume continues past the target window at this order.

scans.label: NL-HaNA_1.01.02_6896_0450.jpg
scans.finding: Letter from Livorno, partly legible date "...1622"; Italian text on the facing page -- unrelated correspondent, confirms the volume mixes many Mediterranean/Levant correspondents throughout, not a single chronological Haga run.
